diagnoses.description: Incorrect LMP sign: the skill states LMPs are the duals of nodal balance constraints directly, but with the demonstrated balance constraint written as `pg_at_bus - pd == B @ theta` (i.e., load enters with a negative sign), the marginal cost of increasing load is the negative of the dual (LMP = -dual * baseMVA). Using `dual * baseMVA` will flip LMP signs.

Counterfactual congestion flag logic conflicts with the task contract: the skill computes `congestion_relieved = was_binding_in_base and not is_binding_in_cf`, but the task defines the flag based on whether the adjusted line is binding in the counterfactual ("true indicates not binding"), without requiring it to have been binding in the base case.

DC network modeling is incomplete for MATPOWER branch records: the B-matrix construction and line flow formulas ignore transformer tap ratios/phase shifts and also do not filter out out-of-service branches (BR_STATUS). This yields incorrect flows/constraints for transformers and can incorrectly include disconnected elements in the network model.

Economic dispatch snippet contains a concrete variable-name error: it defines `gens` but then uses `gen[8]`/`gen[9]` (undefined) when showing how to read PMAX/PMIN, which would cause runtime errors or mis-implementation if followed literally.
